module_summary: Stream-to-memory adapter that forwards request streams to a memory port while an outstanding-request counter limits issue and a fall-through FIFO buffers memory responses into a valid/ready response stream.

anchors.name: req_i
anchors.why: Request payload forwarded directly to mem_req_o.

anchors.name: req_valid_i
anchors.why: Request valid gated into mem_req_valid_o and counter increment.

anchors.name: req_ready_o
anchors.why: Request ready combining memory ready and outstanding-limit check.

anchors.name: mem_req_o
anchors.why: Memory request payload copied from req_i.

anchors.name: mem_req_valid_o
anchors.why: Memory request valid gated by outstanding-request limit.

anchors.name: mem_resp_i
anchors.why: Memory response data pushed into response buffer.

anchors.name: mem_resp_valid_i
anchors.why: Memory response valid pushing into the response FIFO.

anchors.name: resp_o
anchors.why: Response payload output from response FIFO.

anchors.name: resp_valid_o
anchors.why: Response valid from FIFO; decrements outstanding counter on transfer.

anchors.name: resp_ready_i
anchors.why: Response consumer ready popping the FIFO.

anchors.name: cnt_q
anchors.why: Outstanding request count limiting issue to BufDepth.

anchors.name: req_ready
anchors.why: Capacity-available flag gating request ready and memory valid.

groups.name: Outstanding request control
groups.description: Counts outstanding requests and gates request handshakes.

groups.name: Request forwarding
groups.description: Passes request payload from stream to memory port.
